member.summary: Business logic for fixed-asset management. Enforces RBAC at the service layer (UI also disables buttons but UI-only enforcement is forbidden by spec §9.1). Every CUD operation goes through IUnitOfWork so the audit interceptor fires.

member.name: M:MAIMS.Services.Asset.AssetService.GetContext

member.name: T:MAIMS.Services.Audit.AuditService
member.summary:
Read side of the audit log. Writes are performed by the EF interceptor via IAuditWriter, so this service exposes only LogAsync (for explicit, non-CUD audit events like LOGIN) and the search/export methods used by auditors.
Lifetime: SCOPED (registered as Scoped). Uses IServiceScopeFactory because some callers (like AuditService from a background thread) may need to create their own scope.

member.name: M:MAIMS.Services.Audit.AuditService.PurgeInvalidEntriesAsync(System.String,System.Boolean,System.Threading.CancellationToken)
member.summary: Purges audit_log entries with invalid entity_id (≤ 0) or all entries. Requires a ROOT connection string because the BEFORE DELETE trigger must be temporarily dropped. Steps: 1. Connect as root 2. DROP TRIGGER trg_audit_log_block_delete 3. DELETE FROM audit_log WHERE entity_id <= 0 (or all) 4. CREATE TRIGGER trg_audit_log_block_delete (recreates immutability) 5. Returns the number of rows deleted

member.name: T:MAIMS.Services.Auth.AuthService
member.summary:
BCrypt-based authentication service. Stores a 11-cost hash per user. Implements the ICurrentSession contract so the rest of the app can read the logged-in user's identity / permissions without re-querying the DB.
Lifetime: SINGLETON. Because singleton cannot directly resolve scoped services (MaimsDbContext is scoped via DbContextPool), we inject IServiceScopeFactory and create a fresh scope each time we need a DbContext.

member.name: M:MAIMS.Services.Auth.AuthService.#ctor(Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection.IServiceScopeFactory,System.TimeProvider)
member.summary: Construct AuthService with an IServiceScopeFactory. Each operation creates a fresh DI scope to resolve scoped services (DbContext).

member.name: M:MAIMS.Services.Auth.AuthService.HashPassword(System.String)
member.summary: Hashes a password using BCrypt at cost 11. Used by the seeder and the user management UI.

member.name: T:MAIMS.Services.Inventory.InventoryService
member.summary: Inventory management: item catalog, stock receipt/issue/transfer/adjustment/write-off. Every mutation runs in a transaction that updates StockBalance AND writes a StockTransaction AND fires the audit interceptor — all atomic.

member.name: T:MAIMS.Services.Reference.ReferenceDataService
member.summary: Read-only lookup service for reference data. Uses IServiceScopeFactory because the service is registered as Scoped and the DbContext is also Scoped.

member.name: M:MAIMS.Services.ServiceCollectionExtensions.AddMaimsServices(Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection.IServiceCollection)
member.summary: Registers all MAIMS business services. Must be called AFTER AddMaimsData() AND after AuthService is registered by the host (Program.cs). AuthService is registered as a singleton because it doubles as the ICurrentSession holder (per-process single active user in the WinForms host).
